reviews.review: Not a huge 3rd person view gamer at all..in fact, this is my first one. All about FPS. As a huge aliens fan, i loved this game as it incorporates aspects from the entire ALIEN universe. The atmosphere during gaming is amazing and fast paced. If you are an alien fan, get this game. For the casual gamer, its satisfying to build up a loadout and customize weapons and accessories. It almost has a base builder feel when you can set mines, and sentry turrets to make a choke hold position.
it was alright for what it is

A lot has changed since release, the devs have greatly improved the experience, and if you're an Aliens fan this will scratch that itch. loving the upgrades and difficulty tiers. Highly recommend if you have some friends to play with

This game is epic on insane, a very underrated game. Can make you rage, but still awesome, hope there are more updates.

This game is a bit of a mixed bag. It's an alright game, its an accomplishment for a smaller studio like Cold Iron, but its got its problem. Cold Iron doesn't have the budget of AAA releases like Battlefield and COD, so a lot is missing here. The characters' mouth don't move, which is pretty jarring. This is a game that you HAVE to play with other players, the bots are basically just bullet sponges that follow you around. AI Teammates suck, and you'll come to hate them. The aliens themselves feel more like storm troopers than aliens. Colonial Marines had the best story, Isolation did the xenomorphs and atmosphere the best. Fireteam elites is just, a big blah. Mediocre, and absolutely dependent on a large consistent player base, which this game is lacking. They have the Aliens License, do more with it! This game might have been immensely helped if there was a single player mode, where the teammates weren't just androids, but voiced marine AI teammates, like Republic Commando and Ghost Recon, make them bad ass, lovable, useful, and helpful! Instead, you get these god awful silent androids that might as well be planks of wood. The game needs that large player base to be fun, but it doesn't. Finding others in matchmaking takes forever. If you wanna buy this game, wait till it comes on sale. And wait till they give you a better single player experience, otherwise you'll be forever trapped in matchmaking!

As a fan of the alien franchise this was heartbreaking. Amazing artwork and attention to detail it's so darn pretty to look at every part of each map, but it's lipstick on a pig. To keep it short and simple save your money or wait for an update and wait for it to go on sale. Repetitive gameplay. A.I. bots for replacement of team members will fail you in combat. God there's just not a lot to do right now. For a game to come out literally 3 months ago and an official announcement 8 months ago the matchmaking is embarrassingly dry. As of now when this review was made you will not I REPEAT will not get the multiplayer experience you were hoping for. The release for this game was so sudden but at the same time it didn't feel rushed because of the amount of gorgeous detail to just EVERYTHING! I should've known better than to get my hopes up but I was blinded by my love for the alien franchise, as they say you do stupid things when you're in love. Hoping it gets better.

-First impressions are shallow. But the perk trees and class synergy are fairly deep once you get past level IV.

-Combat is smooth, even when horde after horde is coming down on you.

-I would never play without friends or discord servers.

-Loot is a hard earned reward, as opposed to other games which constantly interrupt game-play by burying you with ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ gear and weapons every fifth kill.

7.5 out of 10

I would only get this game if it were on sale, and you had 2 friends to play with. As a big fan of the Alien franchise, that hurt to say. Pro's: Great artwork/graphics, multiple classes, weapon customization, variety of weapons is decent. Attention to detail from cannon lore. Con's: Very limited number of maps. 12 maps in total. 4 areas, with 3 levels per area. It makes for a very short game. WORST A.I. EVER! If you do not have friends to co-op, this is an impossible game at harder difficulties. It would be better if you could choose to not take any bots along at all, and have the game adjust difficulty accordingly/do something about enemy grapple. The a.i. controlled bots will not shoot at enemies, will go out of their way to stand in front of you while you are shooting enemies, or will not help defend you when attacked/grappled. Enemy grapple mechanics are glitchy as all get up. Enemy able to grapple you at extreme distance and through walls. If you miraculously avoid a grapple, enemy rubber-bands back to point where they tried to grapple from. Many maps are very tight, i.e. cramped hallways. (and this feels even more cramped when the bots just keep walking into the barrel of your gun.) Spawning mechanics allows xeno's to spawn in a space that you are currently occupying, which leads to a glitch where you cannot shoot the enemy or dodge away from the enemy meaning you have to rely on co-op help or die. Weird enemy bug where they fall through the floor/wall while advancing and then eat your toe beans without you being able to attack. 

You can tell someone who really loved the Aliens franchise worked on this. It has so much potential. That being said, the game should not have been released until it was actually complete. This absolutely stinks of a money grab. I really hope they put out more content. If they do, I hope they don't charge people for it, since the cost of the game for what we got was not worth it.
